_comment: Sentence set for the entrar activation probe (Discussion 3 Sec 6 / Discussion 4). Four conditions -- antagonist_only, interior_only, blend, and neutral (no PROCESS, no CONTAINER; a plain property ascription, the negative control for both probes) -- each realized with the same 6 name/container pairs so lexical identity doesn't confound the class label. Every sentence is two clauses: a first clause carrying the role content, and an identical neutral second clause ('{Name} sorriu.', name smiled) that reintroduces the entity. 'target_surface' is extracted at its LAST occurrence (the second clause) deliberately -- in a causal decoder, a token's hidden state can only attend to what precedes it, so a sentence-initial name (the first clause's subject) can never be influenced by the role-disambiguating content that follows it. The second mention can attend back across the whole first clause, so it's the only position where role information can actually show up.
